verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since 1Password is a cloud service that holds user data and could document an AI-training opt-out or a no-training policy, but the evidence contains no such policy or control. End-to-end encryption and the Environments MCP server not returning secret values are adjacent security properties, not a documented guarantee or setting that keeps user data out of model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
